title: Let the Court name the honor
summary: Those who meet the Guru in loving faith are accepted, and the True One gives them a place in the Lord's Court. Let love-filled attunement matter more than visible credit.
takeaway: Serve from love and let the Court name the honor.
lifeApplication: Before angling for recognition, do one faithful act with no witness and place its worth before the True One.

source.shortMeaning: Meeting the Guru with loving faith makes the life accepted, and attunement to the True One brings honor in the Lord's Court.
source.lifeApplication: Before angling for credit, choose the act that would still be worthy if only the Lord saw it.

evidence.coreClaim: The shabad locates honor in loving faith and attunement to the True One.
evidence.turn: Public ranking loses power when the Lord's Court defines acceptance.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before angling for recognition, do one faithful act with no witness and place its worth before the True One.
